pair.title: Connect to your P1 Monitor
pair.subtitle: Enter the address of your ZTATZ P1 Monitor. Homey checks the connection before adding the device.
pair.url_hint: The IP address or host name you use to open the P1 Monitor in your browser, for example 192.168.1.50.
pair.url_prefilled: Filled in from your other ZTATZ devices. Change it if you want to add another P1 Monitor.
pair.apikey_hint: Only needed when you connect over HTTPS with an API token configured in the P1 Monitor. Leave empty on your local network.
pair.error_empty: Enter the address of your P1 Monitor.
